lines.text: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, heaven was silent for about half an hour, and seven angels received trumpets.
An angel with a golden censer offered incense with the saints' prayers, and the smoke rose before God.
The angel filled the censer with fire from the altar and hurled it to the earth, and an earthquake came.
The first trumpet brought hail and fire mixed with blood; at the second, a third of the chariots were destroyed.
The star Wormwood fell on a third of the rivers, and a lion cried woe over the last three trumpets.
